adaptations: Release Maestro semantic tokens, typography and motion
Semantic app-icon glyphs instead of Lucide
Token-aware Tailwind merging
Progress indicator respects max and uses the success color; segments support semantic colors and per-segment glow
Button preserves native static tabindex and accepts dynamic tabindex input
TemplateRef dialog service rendering with implicit context
Field description inputs forwarded to native controls
Select highlight follows Brain data-highlighted state
Two-arc SVG spinner preserves original geometry, colors and ambient motion
Content-sized controls and a plain button variant preserve existing appearance
Internal and external text link variants inherit surrounding typography
Disabled fill applies only to filled button variants
Card is a plain panel unless composed from header/content/footer parts
Native textarea rows and explicit field spacing preserve original form layout
Tooltips use a 600ms delay and wrap within 24rem and the viewport
Tooltips skip redundant descriptions; overflow tooltip shows only for clipped text
Pinned Brain tooltip patch captures nested scroll and dismisses pending or hovered overlays
Pinned Brain dialog patch leaves the dialog open on an Escape a menu or select inside it already handled
Navigation button variant follows aria-current for native route links
Inline link buttons can shrink with their containing row

Sidebar copies only the static menu, group and sub-menu parts; the collapsible container, mobile sheet, cookie state, rail, trigger, inset, input, skeleton and badge are omitted, and menu buttons follow aria-current like the navigation button
Switch track insets its thumb with Tailwind sizes and exposes focus() for focus restoration
